measurement_method.circle: Bounding box of alpha >= 128; diameters are width and height, center is midpoint of inclusive extreme coordinates.
measurement_method.gold_rim: Median radial complete gold-colored band width over 720 rays sampled at 0.1px using nearest-pixel sampling; radial search 550..640px. Filter R>0.95G, G>0.35R, B<0.9G, alpha>=128. This includes dark gold bevel and excludes red/blue/green enamel. Identical method for reference and outputs.
